Proposition
[Uniqueness for Ricci--DeTurck flow] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0175 1. ch12:12.12\group Ricci–DeTurck Flow

Let $(M,\widetilde g)$ be complete with bounded curvature. A solution $g(t)$ of Ricci--DeTurck flow with prescribed initial metric is unique among solutions satisfying, for one finite $A$, \[ A^{-1}\widetilde g\leq g(t)\leq A\widetilde g, \qquad |\widetilde abla g(t)|+\sqrt t,|\widetilde abla ^2g(t)|\leq A. \]

Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:complete-manifold-scalar-wmp-barrier ↗ ex:wmp-integrable-time-coefficient For two such solutions $g, ar g$, the standard difference computation gives

\[ (\partial _t-g^{j\ell }\widetilde abla _j\widetilde abla _\ell ) |g- ar g|^2\leq (Ct^{-1/2}+C^2)|g- ar g|^2. \]

The coefficient is integrable and the difference vanishes initially. The integrable-coefficient estimate applied to the nonnegative function $|g- ar g|^2$ gives $g= ar g$.

□
